title: The Ski Bus driving through town
notes: The depot now stands outside town at (657, 608.7, 553.3); the coach (SkiCoachBus, one in the city; its id changes on every load: find it once with __coach()) drives about 4.5 km to the hotel stop near the Grand Lodge. Its road through town is the parallel street, a straight line from about (2510, -1662) to (2852, -1360) (direction (0.75, 0.662)); the coach drives it north-east inbound and south-west outbound, at roughly 15 m/s at sim speed 1, with a stop near (2682, -1504). The scouted 'MediumRoad straight' near the depot was not used: the frame there has no town behind. Camera: a locked Photo Mode camera on the street's south-east verge, 17 m from the road line at 129 m along it (about (2618, 787.2, -1589.4)), 2.3 m above the snow, looking north-west across the street at the shops, 28 mm, a 3 m drift with the traffic. The verge is full of firs; this spot is the one 29 m gap (along 113 to 142 m, offset under 28 m). Light: Photo Mode Time of Day 13 (sun from the south on the coach's side facing the camera). Trigger: poll the coach's InterpolatedTransform every 100 ms at sim speed 1 and start the sequence when its position along the street passes 90 m, driving north-east (it then crosses the frame center about 2 s into the path). Icons and outlines: Photo Mode overlay hidden plus the overlay op. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
